topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell rings, interrupting the silence of the room. I gently place my book on the armchair and walk to the door, greeted by a bouquet of white lilies. No card, no note, just the soothing scent of the flowers filling the air. I thank the delivery person and step back inside, setting the vase on the kitchen counter. I find a jug and fill it with water, the routine familiar and comforting. The unknown sender remains a mystery, but the beauty of the flowers speaks volumes. I smile, appreciating the gesture, and the day feels a little brighter.
